verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS expense product, but the evidence only shows how to run the open-source client app locally for development; nothing documents self-hosting the core Expensify service or backend. Running a dev web server for the frontend is a developer building block, not a self-hosted deployment of the product. missing for 10: documented self-hosted deployment of the core backend/service, self-hosting install and operations docs, and any independent confirmation that a self-hosted instance works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
